newsitem.title: UK: Nigeria's Kaduna refinery maintenance soon - OPECNA.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria's Kaduna refinery maintenance soon - OPECNA.

text.p: Nigeria's Oil Minister Dan Etete said on Thursday that the Kaduna refinery in northern Nigeria would go into maintenance turnaround soon, the OPEC news agency reported on Friday.
Speaking on Nigerian television, Etete said maintenance at Nigeria's other refineries would follow soon, OPECNA reported.
The Kaduna plant has a capacity of 105,000 barrels per day (bpd), but was operating at only 50 percent capacity, according to a recent report from Nigeria's Department of Petroleum Resources.
The minister said: "We must maintain these refineries because we are not planning to build any new ones."
